# Audio cog fails to load after update

## Description

After updating to the latest version, the audio cog fails to load completely. The bot starts up but the audio functionality is completely broken.

## How to Reproduce

1. Update to the latest version
2. Start the bot
3. Try to use any audio command

When trying to load the cog, it fails with an import error. Looking at the logs, it seems there's an issue with the managed_node module.

## Expected behavior

The audio cog should load properly and all audio commands should work as they did before the update.

## Additional context

I noticed that the error happens specifically when trying to import from the managed_node package. It seems like there might be an issue with the file structure or imports in that package.

When I tried to manually inspect the files, I found that some of the files in the managed_node directory contain strange text instead of proper Python code. For example, one file starts with "To reverse the changes indicated by the diff patch..." which is definitely not valid Python.

actions.old_string: Since the diff patch indicates that the entire file was added (as it was previously non-existent), reversing this change means removing all the lines that were added. Therefore, the output should be an empty file.
